paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是恐惧，不过最好笑的地方在于，大人其实一点也不比孩子胆大，只是他们更会装。

Phil 和 Luke 开始怀疑房子底下可能藏着什么宝贝。两个人都很想去探险，可 Phil 其实特别怕下面那个又黑又窄、到处都是虫子的空间。于是他自己不下去，先把 Luke 的遥控小卡车绑上摄像头送了进去。

结果 Phil 把车弄丢了。Luke 很不开心，因为那是 Jay 送他的圣诞礼物，于是干脆自己钻到房子下面去找。然后他的皮带卡在一根管子上，整个人动不了了。Phil 一听儿子被困住，马上顾不上什么蜘蛛、黑暗和狭窄，直接钻进去救人。

Phil 把 Luke 解救出来，短暂地觉得自己像个英雄。可 Luke 还是要把遥控车找回来，于是两个人继续往里走。等 Phil 真钻进去以后，反而慢慢放松下来，甚至开始觉得这场探险挺好玩——直到他们看到几具怎么看都像尸体的东西。父子俩尖叫着逃出去，还叫来了警察。最后才发现，那些“尸体”只是上一任屋主留下的万圣节装饰。

与此同时，Haley 正在第三次参加驾照考试。如果这次再挂，她得等六个月才能重考，所以人还没上车就已经快崩溃了。Claire 让她做三次深呼吸，放松一点。

偏偏 Haley 又碰上了之前挂过她的那个严格考官。考试过程中她越来越紧张，最后直接哭了出来。考官承认，Haley 很像自己的女儿，也正因为这样，他才对她特别严格——他是真的想让她变成一个安全的司机。Haley 得到一次机会，最后终于通过。然后她一高兴，差点因为忘记挂停车挡让车自己滑走。

Alex 也在害怕。学校舞会快到了，她担心根本没人会请自己跳舞。Claire 给她的建议还是同一套：先深呼吸三次。

在 Jay 和 Gloria 家，Manny 假装生病，因为他不想去一个办在游乐园的生日派对。Gloria 一眼就知道，他其实是怕过山车。她和 Jay 硬把 Manny 带过去，还教育他必须面对恐惧。结果 Gloria 很快发现，Jay 自己也怕。Manny 说 Jay 不上，自己也不上，于是 Jay 只能硬着头皮一起坐。

Mitchell 和 Cameron 则把 Lily 的儿科医生请来吃早午餐，因为两个人特别想成为她最喜欢的病人。吃饭时 Lily 突然说了一声“Mommy”。Cameron 当场心碎，开始怀疑 Lily 是不是本能地知道自己“缺一个妈妈”。医生安慰他们，Lily 已经有两个非常爱她的父亲。

后来他们才发现真相：Lily 的娃娃一捏就会说“Mommy”。Lily 只是把这个声音学了下来。

到了结尾，每个人还是有自己害怕的东西。区别只是，大多数人最后都能带着害怕继续往前走。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about fear, but the funny part is that the adults are just as scared as the kids. They’re simply better at pretending they’re not.

Phil and Luke become convinced there might be treasure hidden under the house. They both want to explore, but Phil is secretly terrified of the dark crawl space and all the insects down there. So instead of going in himself, he sends Luke’s remote-controlled truck under the house with a camera attached.

Phil loses the truck. Luke is upset because it was a Christmas present from Jay, so he crawls under the house to get it himself. Then his belt gets caught on a pipe. The second Phil hears that Luke is trapped, he stops thinking about spiders and tight spaces and goes in after him.

Phil frees Luke, and for a moment he feels pretty heroic. Luke still wants his truck, though, so they keep going. Once they’re both under the house, Phil starts relaxing and even enjoys the adventure—right up until they find what look like dead bodies. They run out screaming and call the police. The “bodies” turn out to be old Halloween decorations left by the previous owner.

Meanwhile, Haley is taking her driving test for the third time. If she fails again, she has to wait six months, so she’s already panicking before she gets in the car. Claire tells her to take three deep breaths and relax.

Haley gets the same examiner who failed her before. During the test she gets overwhelmed and starts crying. He admits she reminds him of his own daughter, which is exactly why he’s so hard on her—he wants her to be safe. Haley gets another chance and finally passes. Then, while celebrating, she almost lets the car roll because she forgets to put it in park.

Alex is scared too. She has a school dance coming up and worries nobody will ask her to dance. Claire gives her the same advice: three deep breaths.

At Jay and Gloria’s house, Manny pretends to be sick because he doesn’t want to go to a birthday party at an amusement park. Gloria knows he’s really afraid of the roller coaster. She and Jay drag him there and tell him he has to face his fear. Then Gloria discovers Jay is scared of the ride too. Manny refuses to go without him, so Jay has no choice but to get on.

Mitchell and Cameron invite Lily’s pediatrician over for brunch because they’re desperate to become her favorite patients. During the meal, Lily suddenly says “Mommy.” Cameron is crushed and starts worrying that Lily somehow knows she’s missing a mother. The doctor reassures them that Lily has two parents who love her.

Later, they find out what really happened: Lily’s doll says “Mommy” when you squeeze it. Lily was just copying the sound.

Everybody is still afraid of something by the end. The difference is that most of them manage to move anyway.
